notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-1), a probe of POST /background. The parent's own turn ends while its task-tool child still runs; per the scenario's unified rule the parent session is held working until the child drains.

text: The parent API session is admitted on its first activity
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The prompt drives the parent to working
The background child's session is admitted
The child is linked to the parent
The parent's own turn ends (its Stop hook) while the child is still running
The child drains AFTER the parent's turn ended
The parent session goes ready only after the last background child drained
